principle: Audit frozen evidence only; do not re-estimate networks, factors, labels, risk models, alpha, costs, or capacity.

status_rule.COMPLETE: Required frozen evidence exists and QA passes when a formal QA file is expected.
status_rule.MISSING_EVIDENCE: Expected frozen evidence was not found.
status_rule.QA_NOT_CONFIRMED: Evidence exists but formal QA was not confirmed.
status_rule.PACKAGING_PENDING: Research evidence exists but final report/document packaging is still required.
